title: Desktop app: Cmd+click on another site or a Tracy screen opens a second app window from a painted spare, and that window keeps its own column widths and conversation selection
steps: S1: Run node --test on packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/test/desktop-open.test.mjs (routeDesktopOpen with how the link was pressed).
S2: Run node --test on packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/test/open-requests.test.mjs (the main process asks a page that opens windows, and opens the window itself, once).
S3: Run node --test on packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/test/window-storage.test.mjs (a second window's copy of the window-level storage keys).
S4: Run node --test on packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/test/window-pool.test.mjs (the spare window's lifecycle).
expect: S1: Cmd/middle/Shift click on another of the viewer's sites answers window on /<siteKey>/?open=browser&page=…; on a Tracy screen (/<siteKey>/…, /new, /ops) answers window on that address; a third party, an admin, a page of the site on screen and any non-screen of Tracy's origin answer external; a plain click (or no disposition) is routed exactly as before.

S2: a page that did not say it opens windows gets the old Cmd+click (browser, unasked); a page that did is asked with the disposition; a window decision on Tracy's origin is opened by the app exactly once and never handed to the page; a window decision off the origin, a window decision for a plain click, and a navigate/tab answer to a Cmd+click all open the browser on the pressed address; a new document must declare windows again.

S3: a second window seeds each window-level key once from the shared value, then writes and removals stay in its own copy (session storage, surviving its reload); the main window's later changes and storage events for those keys never reach it; every other key, drafts included, stays shared.

S4: take() is synchronous and gives the painted spare once; at most one spare is prepared; the refill runs after the turn; signed out or quitting prepares nothing; discard drops the spare and the scheduled refill; dispose ends it for good; a spare that fails to load is destroyed.

selectors.bridge: window.tracyDesktop.window.role, tracyDesktop.protocolVersion 2, links.route({ windows: true, decide(url, how) })

evidence: tasks/evidence/desktop-multi-window/e2e/results.json (the app from source on the local stand: Cmd+click, both timings, isolation both ways, Cmd+B per window, sign-out, offline)
fence: The page names the address; the main process checks it is Tracy's and opens the window once. Only three window-level keys are isolated; drafts, theme, language and site history stay shared

Cmd+click on one of Tracy's screens opens it in a second window

a second window anywhere but Tracy is not obeyed

Cmd+click never moves this window or its side card
a new document has to say again that it opens windows
a second window starts from the shared value
a second window's writes stay in that window
once started, a second window does not follow later changes of the main window
a removal in a second window is remembered there
every other key, drafts included, is shared as before
a reload of the second window keeps that window's values
the main window's storage events about an isolated key do not reach the second window's page
the function carries no outside reference
nothing is ready until the spare has painted
at most one spare is being prepared
two Cmd+clicks in a row
